<function name="Center" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<file line="165-L170">lua/includes/extensions/client/panel.lua</file>
	<description>Centers the panel on its parent. 

See <page>Panel:CenterHorizontal</page> and <page>Panel:CenterVertical</page> for more specialized functions.


	<note>This will center the panel using the current size of the panel, so it should be called **AFTER** setting or adjusting the size of the panel.

Take special care when using <page>Panel:Dock</page> as it will not update the size immediately.

You may want to use <page>Panel:PerformLayout</page> to set positions of child panels.
</note>
</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
</function>
